kind: five-fold confirmation of v18/v19 paired objective
prerequisite: Audited v19 completion and promotion of supcon_final
initialization: Each fold starts independently from its matching v18 external-only adapter and saved heads; never from a host-adapted checkpoint
host_training: Exactly v18 host stage: two equivalent epochs of paired sampling, original seed, objective, optimizer, learning rates, accumulation and max length
readout: Exactly v19: StandardScaler and LogisticRegression C=0.02, max_iter=1000; layers 12/24/36; equal mean log probabilities
control: CE and SupCon use the same fitting rows and paired batch schedules for each fold
primary_gate: SupCon pooled OOF accuracy exceeds CE by >=0.015, with positive gains on at least three of five folds, and exceeds matched unadapted-base OOF by >=0.015
secondary_diagnostics: Prompt-cluster bootstrap, corrected versus new errors, per-class recall; no new gate or layer selection
submission_policy: No direct submission; passing supports larger-data training or separate ensemble validation against a stronger incumbent
limitations: Development prompts have been inspected repeatedly
Fold zero is reused pilot evidence, not new confirmation
External checkpoint is shared across folds but saw no host labels
Global external overlap screen uses unlabeled host text conservatively
Passing does not establish improvement over the complete v16 public ensemble
